guidance: Automate continuous cross-region replication of critical workloads to reduce RTO/RPO. Recommended pattern: Multi-AZ HA for AZ failures, plus Elastic DR for continuous asynchronous cross-region replication, paired with a CloudFormation template to provision secondary region infrastructure on demand. DR also enables point-in-time recovery. Elastic DR supports on-premises to cloud and region-to-region replication with encryption in transit and at rest. If multi-region DR cannot be implemented but is required by business SLAs, an executive must sign a formal risk acceptance.
how_to_check: Are RTO/RPO SLAs defined for all critical applications? Is continuous cross-region replication configured via Elastic DR or equivalent? Is secondary region infrastructure defined as code and deployable on demand? Has a DR failover drill validated recovery meets SLA targets? If multi-region DR is absent, has a formal risk acceptance been signed? For more information: documentation.
